term_mappings.term deposit: A fixed-term deposit product. One row per deposit or deal in t_fsi_me_term_deposits_lv1. A single customer may have multiple deposits across different currencies and tenors.
term_mappings.book balance: Outstanding balance of a deposit expressed in SGD. Column: o_cur_book_bal_sgd (current) or o_avg_book_bal_sgd (average over period).
term_mappings.customer rate: Interest rate given to the customer on the deposit. Derived column: customer_rate.
term_mappings.customer margin: Spread or margin related to the customer rate. Derived column: customer_margin.
term_mappings.transfer pricing: Internal funds transfer pricing in percentage. Derived column: transfer_pricing.
term_mappings.liquidity premium: Internal value assigned for liquidity risk, in percentage. Derived column: liquidity_premium.
term_mappings.interest expense: Interest cost the bank pays on the deposit, MTD in SGD. Column: o_int_exp_sgd.
term_mappings.contractual tenor: Original agreed term of the fixed deposit at the time of booking. Column: contractual_tenor.
term_mappings.remaining tenor: Time left until the fixed deposit matures as of the reporting date. Column: remaining_contractual_tenor.
term_mappings.maturity date: Date when the fixed deposit is due to mature. Column: maturity_date.
term_mappings.origination date: Trade date, date when the deposit started or was first booked. Column: origination_date.
term_mappings.businessdate: Monthly snapshot date. Compulsory filter for all queries against t_fsi_me_term_deposits_lv1. Column: businessdate.
term_mappings.as_of_date: Reporting date for the record. Tells us the snapshot date of the data. Column: as_of_date.
term_mappings.entity: The legal entity that books the deposit. Identified by column cntry. Entity Singapore is represented as 'SG'.
term_mappings.segment: Business segment the deposit belongs to. Three primary segments: Retail, Group Wholesale Banking (GWB), and Financial Institutions. Column: segment.
term_mappings.GWB: Group Wholesale Banking. One of the three primary business segments. Refers to corporate and institutional banking clients.
term_mappings.FI: Financial Institutions. One of the three primary business segments. Refers to deposits from other banks and financial entities.
term_mappings.GL product code: General ledger product code for the deposit. Used in financial reporting. Column: gl_product_code.
term_mappings.SIBS product code: Internal product code used in SIBS or the source banking system. Column: product_code_in_sibs.
term_mappings.fund charge: Transfer pricing MTD in SGD. Column: o_fund_chg_cr_sgd.
term_mappings.strategic adjustment: Manual payment or penalty adjustment MTD in SGD. Column: o_strategic_adjust_sgd.
